analysis.title: Nasdaq On The Edge AI Cracks, Volatility Explodes, Skew Goes Haywire
key_insights: NDX remains inside the trading range in place since May, with 29k (futures) named as the make-or-break level.
Tech volatility is rising sharply while Nasdaq holds the range. VXN has pushed to fresh recent highs while VIX remains below Friday's highs.
SOX is breaking below the trading range in place since May, apart from one brief overshoot and undershoot. The 200-day moving average sits slightly lower and momentum is very weak.
SMH volatility had been unusually depressed for weeks. VXSMH has now surged sharply higher.
KOSPI led the global AI rally on the way up and is leading the AI unwind on the way down.

Goldman's Privorotsky reports growing fatigue and caution among institutional investors after New York meetings. Prime brokerage flows show some of the most aggressive tech selling in recent memory, with managers cutting net exposure while largely maintaining gross.
AI allocations have fallen significantly, though none of the investors Privorotsky met were outright short. Capital preservation dominates into year-end.
AI demand remains robust, but funding, power constraints and the sustainability of capex are increasingly questioned.
Downside protection spiked last Friday as the SDEX skew index surged. The spike fully reversed over a few calmer sessions, and skew is rising again as markets sell off today.
Apple continues to defy the AI narrative. The Market Ear's relative AAPL vs NVDA trade has worked, and Apple risks becoming the unintended winner of the AI unwind.
